---
name: Profile or portfolio feedback
about: Suggest a correction to public profile content, links, accessibility or documentation.
---

**What needs attention?**

Identify the public page, file, link or section and describe the issue.

**Suggested correction**

Explain the proposed change and, if applicable, provide a public source that supports it.

**Scope and privacy**

This is the public profile repository, not a product support channel. Do not include credentials, personal documents, private research data or vulnerability details. Use [confidential security reporting](https://github.com/GOD13emad/GOD13emad/security/advisories/new) for security issues in this repository.
